sql:
WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, ROUND(STDDEV(shipping_fee), 2) AS stddev_shipping_fee, COUNT(amount) AS amount_count
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    customers.credit_limit,
    customers.email,
    customer_totals.stddev_shipping_fee,
    customer_totals.amount_count
FROM customers
INNER JOIN customer_totals ON customers.id = customer_totals.customer_id
ORDER BY 3 DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customer_totals = (
    df_orders
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("shipping_fee"), 2).alias("stddev_shipping_fee"),
        F.count("amount").alias("amount_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_customers.alias("customers")
    .join(customer_totals.alias("customer_totals"), F.col("customers.id") == F.col("customer_totals.customer_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("customers.credit_limit"),
        F.col("customers.email"),
        F.col("customer_totals.stddev_shipping_fee"),
        F.col("customer_totals.amount_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("stddev_shipping_fee").desc())
)

sql: WITH recent_products AS (SELECT *, cost / NULLIF(stock_qty, 0) AS cost_per_stock_qty FROM products WHERE launch_date < '2025-03-23' OR brand NOT IN ('Acme', 'Stark', 'Umbrella')), products_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN stock_qty >= 388 THEN 'high' WHEN stock_qty >= 75 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS stock_qty_bucket, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(brand))) AS brand_values FROM recent_products GROUP BY CASE WHEN stock_qty >= 388 THEN 'high' WHEN stock_qty >= 75 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT stock_qty_bucket, brand_values FROM products_stats;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_products = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") < "2025-03-23") | ~F.col("brand").isin(["Acme", "Stark", "Umbrella"]))
    .withColumn("cost_per_stock_qty", (F.col("cost") / F.nullif("stock_qty", F.lit(0))))
)

products_stats = (
    recent_products
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("stock_qty") >= 388, "high").when(F.col("stock_qty") >= 75, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("stock_qty_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("brand"))).alias("brand_values"))
)

result = products_stats.select("stock_qty_bucket", "brand_values")

SELECT
    id,
    region,
    city,
    opened_date,
    sqft,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY opened_date) opened_date_pct_rank,

code:

        "region",
        "city",

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE amount < 1900), summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 3800 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS amount_bucket, COUNT(amount) AS amount_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM src GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 3800 THEN 'high' WHEN amount >= 1000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT amount_bucket, amount_count, total_amount FROM summary WHERE total_amount >= 17000 ORDER BY amount_count DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = df_transactions.filter(F.col("amount") < 1900)

summary = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 3800, "high").when(F.col("amount") >= 1000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("amount").alias("amount_count"),
        F.sum("amount").alias("total_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("total_amount") >= 17000)
    .select("amount_bucket", "amount_count", "total_amount")
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_count").desc())
)

    FROM orders
    WHERE shipping_fee >= 17
    GROUP BY store_id

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), paid_at) days_since_paid_at FROM payments WHERE (order_id = 4 AND order_id IS NULL) OR status = 'SUCCESS'), payments_stats AS (SELECT QUARTER(paid_at) paid_quarter, method, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) success_count, COUNT(*) num_payments FROM base GROUP BY QUARTER(paid_at), method) SELECT paid_quarter, method, num_payments FROM payments_stats WHERE success_count >= 8 ORDER BY num_payments DESC, method ASC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(((F.col("order_id") == 4) & F.col("order_id").isNull()) | (F.col("status") == "SUCCESS"))
    .withColumn("days_since_paid_at", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "paid_at"))
)

payments_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy(F.quarter("paid_at").alias("paid_quarter"), "method")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS", 1)).alias("success_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_payments"),
    )
)

result = (
    payments_stats
    .filter(F.col("success_count") >= 8)
    .select("paid_quarter", "method", "num_payments")
    .orderBy(F.col("num_payments").desc(), "method")
)

sql:
WITH filtered_accounts AS (
    SELECT *, TRIM(account_type) AS clean_account_type
    FROM accounts
    WHERE account_type = 'SAVINGS' AND status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED', 'FROZEN')
),
accounts_stats AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS opened_month,
        status,
        COUNT(DISTINCT balance) AS unique_customers,
        ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_open
    FROM filtered_accounts
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date), status
)
SELECT
    opened_month,
    status,
    unique_customers,
    pct_open
FROM accounts_stats
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_accounts = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("account_type") == "SAVINGS") & F.col("status").isin(["OPEN", "CLOSED", "FROZEN"]))
    .withColumn("clean_account_type", F.trim("account_type"))
)

accounts_stats = (
    filtered_accounts
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("opened_month"), "status")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("balance").alias("unique_customers"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_open"),
    )
)

result = accounts_stats.select("opened_month", "status", "unique_customers", "pct_open")

    from store_sales
    where product_id = 8
    group by product_id
)
select p.id, p.cost, S.unique_products
from products p
left outer join StoreSalesByProduct S on p.id = S.product_id
order by p.cost desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

store_sales_by_product = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 8)
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(F.countDistinct("units").alias("unique_products"))
)

result = (
    df_products.alias("p")
    .join(store_sales_by_product.alias("S"), F.col("p.id") == F.col("S.product_id"), "left")
    .select(F.col("p.id"), F.col("p.cost"), F.col("S.unique_products"))
    .orderBy(F.col("cost").desc())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_employees
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("salary") >= 153000, "high").when(F.col("salary") >= 64000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("salary_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.max("hire_date").alias("last_hire_date"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") >= 4)
    .orderBy(F.col("last_hire_date").desc(), F.col("row_count").desc())
)

WITH valid_order_items AS (
    SELECT *, unit_price * quantity AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (1, 27, 31, 40)
),
Summary AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        product_id,
        MAX(line_total) AS max_line_total,
        ROUND(STDDEV(quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity
    FROM valid_order_items
    GROUP BY order_id, product_id
)
SELECT *
FROM Summary
code:

    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([1, 27, 31, 40]))
    .withColumn("line_total", (F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity")))
)

summary = (
    valid_order_items
    .groupBy("order_id", "product_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("line_total").alias("max_line_total"),
        F.round(F.stddev("quantity"), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"),
    )
)

result = summary

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_customers
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "signup_date").alias("signup_month"))

        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
    .withColumn("cumulative_age", F.sum("total_age").over(w))
)

SELECT
    e.id,
    e.manager_id AS employee_manager_id,
    e.is_remote AS employee_is_remote,
    m.level AS manager_level,
    WEEKOFYEAR(e.hire_date) AS hire_date_weekofyear
FROM employees e

    delivered_date,
    carrier,
    status,
    shipped_date,
    cost,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS row_num,

        "status",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",

        F.lag("cost", 1).over(w2).alias("prev_cost"),
    )
)

SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS paid_month,
    method,
    ROUND(STDDEV(amount), 2) AS stddev_amount,
    ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_cash,
    MIN(amount) AS min_amount
FROM payments
WHERE order_id IN (12, 18, 21, 40)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, 'yyyy-MM'), method
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) >= 78
ORDER BY paid_month DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([12, 18, 21, 40]))

    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("amount"), 2).alias("stddev_amount"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("method") == "cash", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_cash"),
        F.min("amount").alias("min_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("failed_amount"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("failed_amount") >= 78)
    .drop("failed_amount")
    .orderBy(F.col("paid_month").desc())
)

    SELECT *
    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 3, 6) AND product_id = 5 AND product_id = 3
),

    SELECT MONTH(last_restock) AS last_restock_month, AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity, MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range

join suppliers s on s.id = p.supplier_id

sql:
WITH recent_shipments AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM shipments
    WHERE cost <= 75 AND status IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'RETURNED') AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        carrier,
        QUARTER(delivered_date) delivered_quarter,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'RETURNED' THEN 1 END) returned_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Kerry' THEN 1 END) kerry_count
    FROM recent_shipments
    GROUP BY carrier, QUARTER(delivered_date)
)
SELECT
    carrier,
    delivered_quarter,
    returned_count,
    kerry_count
FROM agg
ORDER BY delivered_quarter

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_shipments = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("cost") <= 75) & F.col("status").isin(["IN_TRANSIT", "RETURNED"]) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
)

agg = (
    recent_shipments
    .groupBy("carrier", F.quarter("delivered_date").alias("delivered_quarter"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", 1)).alias("returned_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Kerry", 1)).alias("kerry_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .select("carrier", "delivered_quarter", "returned_count", "kerry_count")
    .orderBy("delivered_quarter")
)

sql:
SELECT
    s.region,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s.opened_date) AS opened_month,
    MAX(i.quantity) AS max_quantity,
    ROUND(AVG(i.quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN stores s ON s.id = i.store_id
WHERE i.store_id IN (3, 4)
GROUP BY s.region, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', s.opened_date)
HAVING MAX(i.quantity) >= 90
ORDER BY max_quantity DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("i.store_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("i.store_id").isin([3, 4]))
    .groupBy(
        F.col("s.region"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", F.col("s.opened_date")).alias("opened_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("max_quantity"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("i.quantity")), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("max_quantity") >= 90)
    .orderBy(F.col("max_quantity").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT
    product_id,
    order_id,
    MAX(unit_price) - MIN(unit_price) AS unit_price_range,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS order_item_count
FROM order_items
WHERE quantity < 5 AND (quantity = 7 OR order_id IN (9, 33))
GROUP BY product_id, order_id
HAVING ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) > 73
ORDER BY order_id, 1 DESC
LIMIT 50;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter((F.col("quantity") < 5) & ((F.col("quantity") == 7) | F.col("order_id").isin([9, 33])))
    .groupBy("product_id", "order_id")
    .agg(
        (F.max("unit_price") - F.min("unit_price")).alias("unit_price_range"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.count("*").alias("order_item_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_quantity") > 73)
    .orderBy("order_id", F.col("product_id").desc())
    .limit(50)
)

sql:
select
    case when s.rating >= 4.3 then 'high' when s.rating >= 1.6 then 'mid' else 'low' end as rating_bucket,
    s.country,
    count(distinct p.cost) as unique_suppliers,
    count(p.stock_qty) as stock_qty_count
from products p
inner join suppliers s on s.id = p.supplier_id
where s.supplier_name is null
group by case when s.rating >= 4.3 then 'high' when s.rating >= 1.6 then 'mid' else 'low' end, s.country
order by unique_suppliers desc, rating_bucket desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_products.alias("p")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("p.supplier_id"), "inner")

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("s.rating") >= 4.3, "high").when(F.col("s.rating") >= 1.6, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.col("s.country"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct(F.col("p.cost")).alias("unique_suppliers"),
        F.count(F.col("p.stock_qty")).alias("stock_qty_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("unique_suppliers").desc(), F.col("rating_bucket").desc())

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 380 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, MIN(unit_price) AS min_unit_price, MAX(unit_price) - MIN(unit_price) AS unit_price_range
FROM order_items
WHERE NOT (order_id IN (30, 38) AND product_id = 3)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 380 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY unit_price_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(~(F.col("order_id").isin([30, 38]) & (F.col("product_id") == 3)))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 380, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 130, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )

SELECT
    product_id,
    CASE WHEN quantity >= 8 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 3 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket,
    CASE WHEN unit_price >= 340 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
    AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT unit_price) AS unique_orders
FROM order_items
WHERE quantity BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY product_id, CASE WHEN quantity >= 8 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 3 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 340 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END

code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 340, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 130, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("quantity").alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.countDistinct("unit_price").alias("unique_orders"),
    )

sql:
SELECT
    product_id,
    CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
    order_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS unique_orders,
    MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range,
    MAX(unit_price) - MIN(unit_price) AS unit_price_range
FROM order_items
WHERE order_id IN (11, 21)
GROUP BY product_id, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 100 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, order_id
ORDER BY 6 DESC, product_id DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([11, 21]))
    .groupBy(
        "product_id",
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 360, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 100, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("quantity").alias("unique_orders"),
        (F.max("quantity") - F.min("quantity")).alias("quantity_range"),
        (F.max("unit_price") - F.min("unit_price")).alias("unit_price_range"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("unit_price_range").desc(), F.col("product_id").desc())
)

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN s.rating >= 3.9 THEN 'high' WHEN s.rating >= 1.9 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END rating_bucket, MIN(i.last_restock) first_last_restock, MAX(i.quantity) - MIN(i.quantity) quantity_range
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id
INNER JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = p.supplier_id
GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.rating >= 3.9 THEN 'high' WHEN s.rating >= 1.9 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
HAVING MAX(i.quantity) - MIN(i.quantity) > 21
ORDER BY rating_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("p.supplier_id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("s.rating") >= 3.9, "high").when(F.col("s.rating") >= 1.9, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min(F.col("i.last_restock")).alias("first_last_restock"),
        (F.max(F.col("i.quantity")) - F.min(F.col("i.quantity"))).alias("quantity_range"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("quantity_range") > 21)
    .orderBy("rating_bucket")
)

    signup_date,

)

sql:
SELECT
    s.city,
    s.region,
    AVG(i.quantity) AS avg_quantity,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM inventory i
JOIN stores s ON i.store_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.city, s.region
HAVING AVG(i.quantity) >= 210
ORDER BY city, avg_quantity DESC, region
LIMIT 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")

    .agg(
        F.avg(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.sum(F.col("i.quantity")).alias("total_quantity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_quantity") >= 210)
    .orderBy("city", F.col("avg_quantity").desc(), "region")
    .limit(3)
)

WITH filtered_suppliers AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country IN ('DE', 'SG', 'JP') AND country = 'SG' AND country != 'US'
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN rating >= 3.8 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 2.6 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS rating_bucket, MAX(rating) - MIN(rating) AS rating_range, SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'DE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS de_count
    FROM filtered_suppliers
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN rating >= 3.8 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 2.6 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM summary
ORDER BY rating_bucket
LIMIT 5;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE YEAR(sale_date) >= 2023 AND product_id IN (5, 8)
),
store_sales_stats AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN revenue >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN revenue >= 800 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS revenue_bucket, SUM(units) AS total_units, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue
    FROM src
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN revenue >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN revenue >= 800 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT revenue_bucket, avg_revenue
FROM store_sales_stats
WHERE avg_revenue >= 1700
ORDER BY revenue_bucket;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.year("sale_date") >= 2023) & F.col("product_id").isin([5, 8]))
)

store_sales_stats = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("revenue") >= 4000, "high").when(F.col("revenue") >= 800, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("revenue_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("units").alias("total_units"),
        F.avg("revenue").alias("avg_revenue"),
    )
)

result = (
    store_sales_stats
    .filter(F.col("avg_revenue") >= 1700)
    .select("revenue_bucket", "avg_revenue")
    .orderBy("revenue_bucket")
)

    store_id,

WITH recent_accounts AS (
    SELECT *, TRIM(account_type) AS clean_account_type
    FROM accounts
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL AND (account_type = 'LOAN' OR status != 'CLOSED')
),
account_type_summary AS (
    SELECT account_type, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'SAVINGS' THEN balance ELSE 0 END) AS savings_balance, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) AS status_values
    FROM recent_accounts
    GROUP BY account_type
)
SELECT account_type, status_values
FROM account_type_summary
WHERE savings_balance > 37
ORDER BY account_type

    df_accounts

    .withColumn("clean_account_type", F.trim("account_type"))
)

account_type_summary = (
    recent_accounts
    .groupBy("account_type")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("account_type") == "SAVINGS", F.col("balance")).otherwise(0)).alias("savings_balance"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status"))).alias("status_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    account_type_summary
    .filter(F.col("savings_balance") > 37)
    .select("account_type", "status_values")

)

WITH valid_shipments AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN cost >= 95 THEN 'High' WHEN cost >= 44 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_band
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > '2024-05-01' AND (MONTH(shipped_date) IN (1, 5, 8) OR carrier = 'FedEx')
),
status_summary AS (
    SELECT status, MIN(delivered_date) AS first_delivered_date, MIN(delivered_date) AS min_delivered_date
    FROM valid_shipments

    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > "2024-05-01") & (F.month("shipped_date").isin([1, 5, 8]) | (F.col("carrier") == "FedEx")))
    .withColumn("cost_band", F.when(F.col("cost") >= 95, "High").when(F.col("cost") >= 44, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

    valid_shipments
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.min("delivered_date").alias("first_delivered_date"),
        F.min("delivered_date").alias("min_delivered_date"),
    )
)

    .select("status", "min_delivered_date")
    .orderBy(F.col("min_delivered_date").desc())
)

with src as (
    select *, cast(budget as int) budget_int
    from departments
    where dept_name in ('Legal', 'HR')
),
location_summary as (
    select location, case when budget >= 3333000 then 'high' when budget >= 601000 then 'mid' else 'low' end budget_bucket, count(case when dept_name = 'Engineering' then 1 end) engineering_count
    from src
    group by location, case when budget >= 3333000 then 'high' when budget >= 601000 then 'mid' else 'low' end

sql:
WITH valid_accounts AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN', 'FROZEN') AND balance BETWEEN 34000 AND 63000
),
account_type_summary AS (
    SELECT account_type, status, ROUND(STDDEV(balance), 2) AS stddev_balance
    FROM valid_accounts
    GROUP BY account_type, status
)
SELECT account_type, status, stddev_balance
FROM account_type_summary
WHERE stddev_balance < 79
ORDER BY status;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_accounts = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["CLOSED", "OPEN", "FROZEN"]) & F.col("balance").between(34000, 63000))
)

account_type_summary = (
    valid_accounts
    .groupBy("account_type", "status")
    .agg(F.round(F.stddev("balance"), 2).alias("stddev_balance"))
)

result = (
    account_type_summary
    .filter(F.col("stddev_balance") < 79)
    .select("account_type", "status", "stddev_balance")
    .orderBy("status")
)

sql:
WITH filtered_web_events AS (
    SELECT *, CONCAT(event_type, ' - ', page) AS event_type_page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE (session_id IN (16, 27, 28) AND event_type = 'purchase') OR duration_sec <> 149
),
summary AS (
    SELECT YEAR(event_time) AS event_year, SUM(duration_sec) AS total_duration_sec, ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_duration_sec
    FROM filtered_web_events
    GROUP BY YEAR(event_time)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM web_events
    WHERE NOT (page IN ('/search', '/checkout') AND duration_sec >= 124)
),
web_events_stats AS (
    SELECT
        YEAR(event_time) AS event_year,
        CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 448 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 61 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS duration_sec_bucket,
        COUNT(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_count,
        MAX(event_time) AS last_event_time
    FROM base
    GROUP BY YEAR(event_time), CASE WHEN duration_sec >= 448 THEN 'high' WHEN duration_sec >= 61 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT
    event_year,
    duration_sec_bucket,
    duration_sec_count,
    last_event_time
FROM web_events_stats
WHERE duration_sec_count >= 7
ORDER BY duration_sec_bucket
code:

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(~(F.col("page").isin(["/search", "/checkout"]) & (F.col("duration_sec") >= 124)))
)

web_events_stats = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.year("event_time").alias("event_year"),
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 448, "high").when(F.col("duration_sec") >= 61, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("duration_sec").alias("duration_sec_count"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_event_time"),
    )
)

result = (
    web_events_stats
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec_count") >= 7)
    .select(
        "event_year",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        "duration_sec_count",
        "last_event_time",
    )
    .orderBy("duration_sec_bucket")
)

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT * FROM departments WHERE budget BETWEEN 2591000 AND 2647000 AND location = 'Bangkok'), location_summary AS (SELECT location, MAX(budget) - MIN(budget) AS budget_range, SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'Chiang Mai' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chiang_mai_count FROM src GROUP BY location) SELECT location, chiang_mai_count FROM location_summary ORDER BY location LIMIT 50

)

sql: WITH filtered_accounts AS (SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE (balance < 31000 AND balance >= 61000) OR balance <= 19000), Agg AS (SELECT CASE WHEN balance >= 68000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 21000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS balance_bucket, COUNT(*) AS account_count, ROUND(STDDEV(balance), 2) AS stddev_balance FROM filtered_accounts GROUP BY CASE WHEN balance >= 68000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 21000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT balance_bucket, account_count, stddev_balance FROM Agg WHERE stddev_balance >= 56 ORDER BY stddev_balance DESC;

sql:
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    product_id,
    unit_price,
    LAG(unit_price, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS prev_unit_price,
    unit_price - LAG(unit_price, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS unit_price_change
FROM order_items
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")

result = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        F.lag("unit_price", 1).over(w).alias("prev_unit_price"),
        (F.col("unit_price") - F.lag("unit_price", 1, 0).over(w2)).alias("unit_price_change"),
    )
)

SELECT

FROM (

    SELECT *
    FROM transactions
    WHERE account_id IN (3, 17) AND txn_type IN ('REFUND', 'FEE') AND is_flagged
),

    SELECT txn_type, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN merchant = 'Starbucks' THEN 1 END) AS starbucks_count

)

WITH filtered_order_items AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE (quantity <> 6 AND order_id IN (12, 23, 26)) OR unit_price < 290
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN unit_price >= 330 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
        order_id,
        MAX(quantity) - MIN(quantity) AS quantity_range,
        MAX(unit_price) AS max_unit_price
    FROM filtered_order_items
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 330 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 130 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, order_id
)
SELECT
    unit_price_bucket,
    order_id,
    quantity_range,
    max_unit_price
FROM agg
WHERE max_unit_price > 320;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_order_items = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(((F.col("quantity") != 6) & F.col("order_id").isin([12, 23, 26])) | (F.col("unit_price") < 290))
    .withColumn("quantity_filled", F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)))
)

agg = (
    filtered_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 330, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 130, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max("quantity") - F.min("quantity")).alias("quantity_range"),
        F.max("unit_price").alias("max_unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("max_unit_price") > 320)
    .select("unit_price_bucket", "order_id", "quantity_range", "max_unit_price")
)

WITH valid_accounts AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(balance * 0.85, 2) AS balance_scaled
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN') AND status = 'CLOSED'
),
accounts_stats AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        QUARTER(opened_date) AS opened_quarter,
        ROUND(AVG(balance_scaled), 2) AS avg_balance_scaled,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(account_type)) AS account_type_list
    FROM valid_accounts
    GROUP BY status, QUARTER(opened_date)
)
SELECT
    status,
    opened_quarter,
    avg_balance_scaled,
    account_type_list

LIMIT 20

)

    valid_accounts
    .groupBy("status", F.quarter("opened_date").alias("opened_quarter"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("balance_scaled"), 2).alias("avg_balance_scaled"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("account_type")).alias("account_type_list"),
    )
)

WITH RecentShipments AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(carrier, 'unassigned') AS carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status IN ('IN_TRANSIT', 'RETURNED', 'DELIVERED')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_cost, MAX(cost) - MIN(cost) AS cost_range
    FROM RecentShipments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT *
FROM agg
WHERE delivered_cost < 32
ORDER BY cost_range;

    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["IN_TRANSIT", "RETURNED", "DELIVERED"]))

)

agg = (
    recent_shipments
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "DELIVERED", F.col("cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("delivered_cost"),
        (F.max("cost") - F.min("cost")).alias("cost_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("delivered_cost") < 32)
    .orderBy("cost_range")
)

SELECT
    d.id,
    d.location,
    COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count,
    ROUND(AVG(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.level = 'L3' THEN e.salary ELSE 0 END) AS l3_salary
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id
WHERE e.full_name LIKE 'I%'
GROUP BY d.id, d.location
ORDER BY employee_count DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_departments.alias("d")
    .join(df_employees.alias("e"), F.col("d.id") == F.col("e.dept_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("e.full_name").like("I%"))
    .groupBy(F.col("d.id"), F.col("d.location"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("e.id")).alias("employee_count"),
        F.round(F.avg(F.col("e.salary")), 2).alias("avg_salary"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("e.level") == "L3", F.col("e.salary")).otherwise(0)).alias("l3_salary"),
    )

    FROM payments

),
method_summary AS (
    SELECT method, MIN(amount) min_amount, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) pct_refunded
    FROM filtered_payments
    GROUP BY method
)
SELECT method, min_amount, pct_refunded

WHERE min_amount >= 810
ORDER BY min_amount;

    )
)

sql:
WITH Src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM orders
    WHERE discount >= 0.12 OR customer_id = 32
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 40 THEN 'high' WHEN shipping_fee >= 14 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS shipping_fee_bucket,
        status,
        AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) AS pending_shipping_fee
    FROM Src
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 40 THEN 'high' WHEN shipping_fee >= 14 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, status
)
SELECT shipping_fee_bucket, status, pending_shipping_fee
FROM agg
ORDER BY pending_shipping_fee, status DESC, shipping_fee_bucket
LIMIT 5;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

src = df_orders.filter((F.col("discount") >= 0.12) | (F.col("customer_id") == 32))

agg = (
    src
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 40, "high").when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 14, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("shipping_fee_bucket"),
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("amount").alias("avg_amount"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", F.col("shipping_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("pending_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .select("shipping_fee_bucket", "status", "pending_shipping_fee")
    .orderBy("pending_shipping_fee", F.col("status").desc(), "shipping_fee_bucket")
    .limit(5)
)

sql:
SELECT p.brand, COUNT(oi.quantity) quantity_count, ROUND(STDDEV(oi.unit_price), 2) stddev_unit_price
FROM order_items oi
RIGHT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.price > 730
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY quantity_count DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_order_items.alias("oi")

sql: WITH src AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN rating >= 3.6 THEN 'High' WHEN rating >= 1.7 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS rating_band FROM suppliers WHERE country IN ('US', 'JP') AND (rating BETWEEN 2.2 AND 3.5 OR supplier_name LIKE '%Toky%')), agg AS (SELECT city, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_singapore FROM src GROUP BY city) SELECT city, pct_singapore FROM agg WHERE pct_singapore < 63;

    .filter(F.col("country").isin(["US", "JP"]) & (F.col("rating").between(2.2, 3.5) | F.col("supplier_name").like("%Toky%")))

sql: SELECT merchant, HOUR(txn_time) AS txn_hour, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS merchant_list, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'CREDIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_credit FROM transactions WHERE txn_time < '2025-10-03' GROUP BY merchant, HOUR(txn_time) HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 ORDER BY 2, merchant LIMIT 50;

sql:
with FilteredStores as (
    select *
    from stores
    where opened_date <= '2024-04-07'
),
opened_month_summary as (
    select date_trunc('MONTH', opened_date) as opened_month, case when sqft >= 12724 then 'high' when sqft >= 4930 then 'mid' else 'low' end as sqft_bucket, sum(case when region = 'South' then 1 else 0 end) as south_count
    from FilteredStores
    group by date_trunc('MONTH', opened_date), case when sqft >= 12724 then 'high' when sqft >= 4930 then 'mid' else 'low' end
)
select *
from opened_month_summary
where south_count < 45
order by opened_month asc, south_count desc, sqft_bucket asc
limit 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_stores = df_stores.filter(F.col("opened_date") <= "2024-04-07")

opened_month_summary = (
    filtered_stores
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date").alias("opened_month"),
        F.when(F.col("sqft") >= 12724, "high").when(F.col("sqft") >= 4930, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "South", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("south_count"))
)

result = (
    opened_month_summary
    .filter(F.col("south_count") < 45)
    .orderBy("opened_month", F.col("south_count").desc(), "sqft_bucket")
    .limit(10)
)

sql: WITH valid_subscriptions AS (SELECT * FROM subscriptions WHERE plan IN ('enterprise', 'premium', 'basic') AND plan IN ('standard', 'basic') AND status <> 'ACTIVE'), summary AS (SELECT plan, MAX(monthly_fee) - MIN(monthly_fee) AS monthly_fee_range FROM valid_subscriptions GROUP BY plan) SELECT plan, monthly_fee_range FROM summary WHERE monthly_fee_range >= 50 ORDER BY monthly_fee_range DESC, plan LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_subscriptions = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["enterprise", "premium", "basic"]) & F.col("plan").isin(["standard", "basic"]) & (F.col("status") != "ACTIVE"))
)

summary = (
    valid_subscriptions
    .groupBy("plan")
    .agg((F.max("monthly_fee") - F.min("monthly_fee")).alias("monthly_fee_range"))
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee_range") >= 50)
    .select("plan", "monthly_fee_range")
    .orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_range").desc(), "plan")
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cost >= 88 THEN 'high' WHEN cost >= 34 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS cost_bucket,
    order_id,
    AVG(cost) AS avg_cost,
    CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(carrier))) AS carrier_values
FROM shipments
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING AVG(cost) >= 58
ORDER BY cost_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_shipments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cost") >= 88, "high").when(F.col("cost") >= 34, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("cost_bucket"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("cost").alias("avg_cost"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("carrier"))).alias("carrier_values"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_cost") >= 58)
    .orderBy("cost_bucket")
)

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'LOAN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_loan, MAX(balance) - MIN(balance) AS balance_range

    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        unit_price,
        product_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS pos
    FROM order_items
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    unit_price,
    product_id
FROM top_order_items
WHERE pos <= 3
ORDER BY unit_price
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")

result = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "unit_price",
        "product_id",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("pos"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("pos") <= 3)
    .select("id", "order_id", "unit_price", "product_id")
    .orderBy("unit_price")
)

SELECT s.region, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, ROUND(STDDEV(o.discount), 2) AS stddev_discount
FROM orders o

sql:
with OrderStats as (
    select order_id, sum(case when carrier = 'Flash' then cost else 0 end) as flash_cost
    from shipments
    group by order_id
)
select
    o.id,
    o.amount,
    o.store_id,
    O.flash_cost
from orders o
left join OrderStats O on o.id = O.order_id
where O.flash_cost >= 64
order by flash_cost desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

order_stats = (
    df_shipments
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Flash", F.col("cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("flash_cost"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(order_stats.alias("O"), F.col("o.id") == F.col("O.order_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("O.flash_cost") >= 64)
    .select(
        F.col("o.id"),
        F.col("o.amount"),
        F.col("o.store_id"),
        F.col("O.flash_cost"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("flash_cost").desc())
)

    WHERE NOT (store_id IN (2, 5, 6) AND store_id IN (3, 6))

    SELECT order_id, ROUND(STDDEV(unit_price), 2) AS stddev_unit_price, MIN(quantity) AS min_quantity
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS agg
WHERE min_quantity < 5.5
ORDER BY min_quantity DESC, order_id
LIMIT 50
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("unit_price"), 2).alias("stddev_unit_price"),
        F.min("quantity").alias("min_quantity"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_quantity") < 5.5)
    .select("order_id", "stddev_unit_price", "min_quantity")
    .orderBy(F.col("min_quantity").desc(), "order_id")
    .limit(50)
)

sql: select id, order_id, paid_at, amount, status, sum(amount) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_amount, round(amount / sum(amount) over (partition by status), 3) as amount_share from payments order by running_amount, id desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status")

result = (
    df_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "paid_at",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.sum("amount").over(w).alias("running_amount"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w2)), 3).alias("amount_share"),
    )
    .orderBy("running_amount", F.col("id").desc())
)

sql:
with Base as (
    select *
    from suppliers
    where country in ('TH', 'UK', 'JP')
),
agg as (
    select
        case when rating >= 3.6 then 'high' when rating >= 2.3 then 'mid' else 'low' end rating_bucket,
        country,
        round(stddev(rating), 2) stddev_rating,
        sum(case when country = 'TH' then rating else 0 end) th_rating
    from Base
    group by case when rating >= 3.6 then 'high' when rating >= 2.3 then 'mid' else 'low' end, country
)
select
    rating_bucket,
    country,
    stddev_rating,
    th_rating
from agg
where stddev_rating >= 59
order by stddev_rating;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = df_suppliers.filter(F.col("country").isin(["TH", "UK", "JP"]))

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 3.6, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 2.3, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
        "country",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("rating"), 2).alias("stddev_rating"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "TH", F.col("rating")).otherwise(0)).alias("th_rating"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("stddev_rating") >= 59)
    .select("rating_bucket", "country", "stddev_rating", "th_rating")
    .orderBy("stddev_rating")
)

SELECT

    ss.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.quantity) AS unique_products,
    MAX(i.last_restock) AS latest_last_restock
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id
WHERE i.product_id IN (1, 6, 8, 9)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN ss.revenue >= 4000 THEN 'high' WHEN ss.revenue >= 900 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, ss.product_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.quantity) > 1
ORDER BY product_id DESC, revenue_bucket;

    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("ss"), (F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("ss.store_id")) & (F.col("i.product_id") == F.col("ss.product_id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("i.product_id").isin([1, 6, 8, 9]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("ss.revenue") >= 4000, "high").when(F.col("ss.revenue") >= 900, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("revenue_bucket"),
        F.col("ss.product_id"),
    )
    .agg(

)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget BETWEEN 1118000 AND 1464000 AND budget BETWEEN 2788000 AND 3461000
),
agg AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 3990000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1114000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'New York' THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS new_york_budget
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3990000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1114000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT budget_bucket, new_york_budget
FROM agg
WHERE new_york_budget >= 34
ORDER BY new_york_budget, budget_bucket
LIMIT 10
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget").between(1118000, 1464000) & F.col("budget").between(2788000, 3461000))
)

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3990000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1114000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("location") == "New York", F.col("budget")).otherwise(0)).alias("new_york_budget"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("new_york_budget") >= 34)
    .select("budget_bucket", "new_york_budget")
    .orderBy("new_york_budget", "budget_bucket")
    .limit(10)
)

sql:
WITH recent_accounts AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM accounts
    WHERE customer_id = 6 AND account_type = 'CHECKING'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN balance >= 87000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 16000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS balance_bucket,
        account_type,
        MAX(balance) AS max_balance,
        CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) AS status_values
    FROM recent_accounts
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN balance >= 87000 THEN 'high' WHEN balance >= 16000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, account_type
)
SELECT
    balance_bucket,
    account_type,
    max_balance,
    status_values
FROM agg
WHERE max_balance >= 55000
ORDER BY account_type DESC, max_balance DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_accounts = (
    df_accounts
    .filter((F.col("customer_id") == 6) & (F.col("account_type") == "CHECKING"))
)

agg = (
    recent_accounts
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("balance") >= 87000, "high").when(F.col("balance") >= 16000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("balance_bucket"),
        "account_type",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("balance").alias("max_balance"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status"))).alias("status_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    agg
    .filter(F.col("max_balance") >= 55000)
    .select("balance_bucket", "account_type", "max_balance", "status_values")
    .orderBy(F.col("account_type").desc(), F.col("max_balance").desc())
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, CONCAT(event_type, ', ', page) AS event_type_page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NULL
),
summary AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time) AS event_month, MAX(duration_sec) AS max_duration_sec
    FROM base
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time)
)
SELECT event_month, max_duration_sec
FROM summary;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNull())
    .withColumn("event_type_page", F.concat("event_type", F.lit(", "), "page"))
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "event_time").alias("event_month"))
    .agg(F.max("duration_sec").alias("max_duration_sec"))
)

result = summary.select("event_month", "max_duration_sec")

sql:
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cost,
    cost - LAG(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS cost_change
FROM shipments
WHERE YEAR(shipped_date) = 2023
ORDER BY order_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

result = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.year("shipped_date") == 2023)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        F.sum("cost").over(w).alias("running_cost"),
        (F.col("cost") - F.lag("cost", 1).over(w2)).alias("cost_change"),
    )
    .orderBy("order_id")
)

sql:
select delivered_quarter, pct_kerry, status_values
from (
    select quarter(delivered_date) as delivered_quarter, round((100 * sum(case when carrier = 'Kerry' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_kerry, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(status))) as status_values
    from shipments
    where status not in ('RETURNED', 'LOST', 'DELIVERED')
    group by quarter(delivered_date)
) as sub
where pct_kerry < 74
order by pct_kerry desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "LOST", "DELIVERED"]))
    .groupBy(F.quarter("delivered_date").alias("delivered_quarter"))
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Kerry", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_kerry"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status"))).alias("status_values"),
    )

    MONTH(customers.signup_date) signup_month,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(orders.status)) status_list,
    ROUND(AVG(orders.shipping_fee), 2) avg_shipping_fee
FROM orders

    select dept_id, min(hire_date) as first_hire_date, round((100 * sum(case when job_title = 'Intern' then 1 else 0 end)) / count(*), 1) as pct_intern
    from employees
    group by dept_id
)
select
    d.id,
    d.budget,
    ds.first_hire_date,
    ds.pct_intern
from departments d
left join department_stats ds on d.id = ds.dept_id
where ds.pct_intern > 34
order by ds.first_hire_date
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

department_stats = (
    df_employees
    .groupBy("dept_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("hire_date").alias("first_hire_date"),
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Intern", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_intern"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_departments.alias("d")
    .join(department_stats.alias("ds"), F.col("d.id") == F.col("ds.dept_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("ds.pct_intern") > 34)
    .select(
        F.col("d.id"),
        F.col("d.budget"),
        F.col("ds.first_hire_date"),
        F.col("ds.pct_intern"),
    )
    .orderBy("first_hire_date")
)

sql:
WITH session_totals AS (
    SELECT session_id, SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/search' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_count, SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/checkout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkout_count
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= '2023-12-01'
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
    s.country,
    s.customer_id,
    st.search_count,
    st.checkout_count
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN session_totals st ON s.id = st.session_id
ORDER BY customer_id DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

session_totals = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("event_time") >= "2023-12-01")
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/search", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("search_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/checkout", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("checkout_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_sessions.alias("s")
    .join(session_totals.alias("st"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("st.session_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("s.customer_id"),
        F.col("st.search_count"),
        F.col("st.checkout_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("customer_id").desc())
)

select
    s.region,
    month(s.opened_date) as opened_month,
    max(i.quantity) - min(i.quantity) as quantity_range,
    count(i.quantity) as quantity_count
from inventory i
left outer join products p on p.id = i.product_id
full outer join stores s on s.id = i.store_id

order by quantity_count desc

)

sql: select product_id, case when unit_price >= 450 then 'high' when unit_price >= 80 then 'mid' else 'low' end unit_price_bucket, count(quantity) quantity_count, max(unit_price) - min(unit_price) unit_price_range, sum(quantity * unit_price) revenue from order_items group by product_id, case when unit_price >= 450 then 'high' when unit_price >= 80 then 'mid' else 'low' end order by unit_price_range, 5 desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .groupBy(
        "product_id",
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 450, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 80, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("quantity").alias("quantity_count"),
        (F.max("unit_price") - F.min("unit_price")).alias("unit_price_range"),
        F.sum((F.col("quantity") * F.col("unit_price"))).alias("revenue"),
    )
    .orderBy("unit_price_range", F.col("revenue").desc())
)

WITH valid_inventory AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventory
    WHERE (product_id IN (2, 5, 6, 7) AND product_id IN (1, 3, 7)) OR YEAR(last_restock) >= 2023
),
summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN quantity >= 264 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 30 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM valid_inventory
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN quantity >= 264 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 30 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT *
FROM summary
WHERE total_quantity >= 470
ORDER BY quantity_bucket DESC, total_quantity;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_inventory = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("product_id").isin([2, 5, 6, 7]) & F.col("product_id").isin([1, 3, 7])) | (F.year("last_restock") >= 2023))
)

summary = (
    valid_inventory
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 264, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 30, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"))
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("total_quantity") >= 470)
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_bucket").desc(), "total_quantity")
)

    FROM store_sales
    WHERE revenue < 3100 OR product_id IN (1, 4, 8, 10)
),

        product_id,
        store_id,

    FROM FilteredStoreSales

SELECT
    stores.region,
    QUARTER(stores.opened_date) AS opened_quarter,
    ROUND(STDDEV(store_sales.units), 2) AS stddev_units,
    MIN(store_sales.revenue) AS min_revenue
FROM store_sales
INNER JOIN products ON products.id = store_sales.product_id
INNER JOIN stores ON store_sales.store_id = stores.id
WHERE store_sales.store_id IN (1, 4, 6)
GROUP BY stores.region, QUARTER(stores.opened_date)

    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE (customer_id IN (5, 20, 21, 36) AND customer_id = 35) OR customer_id IN (16, 20, 28, 30)
),

    from transactions

    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("debit_count"),
        F.countDistinct("amount").alias("unique_merchants"),

    o.id,
    o.channel,
    o.amount,
    o.status
FROM orders o
WHERE YEAR(o.order_date) >= 2025 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND p.amount <= 1060)
ORDER BY channel;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders.alias("o")
    .join(df_payments.filter(F.col("amount") <= 1060).alias("p"), F.col("o.id") == F.col("p.order_id"), "left_anti")
    .filter(F.year(F.col("o.order_date")) >= 2025)
    .select(F.col("o.id"), F.col("o.channel"), F.col("o.amount"), F.col("o.status"))
    .orderBy("channel")
)

sql:
WITH supplier_totals AS (
    SELECT supplier_id, MAX(stock_qty) AS max_stock_qty
    FROM products
    GROUP BY supplier_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.rating,
    s.country,
    st.max_stock_qty
FROM suppliers s
JOIN supplier_totals st ON s.id = st.supplier_id
WHERE st.max_stock_qty >= 390
ORDER BY id DESC, s.rating
LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

supplier_totals = (
    df_products
    .groupBy("supplier_id")
    .agg(F.max("stock_qty").alias("max_stock_qty"))
)

result = (
    df_suppliers.alias("s")
    .join(supplier_totals.alias("st"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("st.supplier_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("st.max_stock_qty") >= 390)
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.rating"),
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("st.max_stock_qty"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc(), "rating")
    .limit(10)
)

sql: WITH session_totals AS (SELECT session_id, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS event_type_list, MAX(duration_sec) - MIN(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_range FROM web_events WHERE HOUR(event_time) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 GROUP BY session_id) SELECT s.id, s.device, st.event_type_list, st.duration_sec_range FROM sessions s LEFT JOIN session_totals st ON s.id = st.session_id;
code:

    df_web_events

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating BETWEEN 2.1 AND 3.8 AND country != 'JP' AND country = 'US'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT city, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city))) AS city_values
    FROM base
    GROUP BY city
)
SELECT *
FROM agg
ORDER BY city_values;
code:

    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("rating").between(2.1, 3.8) & (F.col("country") != "JP") & (F.col("country") == "US"))
)

agg = (
    base
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city"))).alias("city_values"))
)

result = agg.orderBy("city_values")

sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 340 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 200 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, MIN(quantity) AS min_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS unique_orders
FROM order_items
WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 340 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 200 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
HAVING MIN(quantity) > 6.8
ORDER BY min_quantity DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("quantity").isNotNull())
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 340, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 200, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("quantity").alias("min_quantity"),
        F.countDistinct("quantity").alias("unique_orders"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_quantity") > 6.8)
    .orderBy(F.col("min_quantity").desc())
)

        product_name,

SELECT
    YEAR(o.order_date) AS order_year,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date) AS order_month,
    MAX(oi.unit_price) - MIN(oi.unit_price) AS unit_price_range,
    MIN(oi.unit_price) AS min_unit_price
FROM order_items oi
INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE oi.quantity = 8
GROUP BY YEAR(o.order_date), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date)
ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC;

        F.date_trunc("MONTH", F.col("o.order_date")).alias("order_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        (F.max(F.col("oi.unit_price")) - F.min(F.col("oi.unit_price"))).alias("unit_price_range"),

SELECT p.category, MAX(ss.sale_date) latest_sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.revenue) unique_stores
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN products p ON ss.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.category
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_store_sales.alias("ss")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("ss.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")

        F.countDistinct(F.col("ss.revenue")).alias("unique_stores"),
    )
)

sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT price) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'Grocery' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS grocery_count, MAX(launch_date) AS latest_launch_date FROM products WHERE brand IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

sql:
WITH session_summary AS (
    SELECT session_id, SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_count, AVG(duration_sec) AS avg_duration_sec
    FROM web_events
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.country,
    s.device,
    ss.home_count,
    ss.avg_duration_sec
FROM sessions s
INNER JOIN session_summary ss ON s.id = ss.session_id
ORDER BY s.country DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

session_summary = (
    df_web_events
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("home_count"),
        F.avg("duration_sec").alias("avg_duration_sec"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_sessions.alias("s")
    .join(session_summary.alias("ss"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("ss.session_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("s.device"),
        F.col("ss.home_count"),
        F.col("ss.avg_duration_sec"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").desc())
)

sql: SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.paid_at, p.amount, o.shipping_fee, o.amount order_amount, GREATEST(o.discount, o.amount) greatest_discount_amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED') OR o.shipping_fee BETWEEN 19 AND 27 ORDER BY order_amount DESC, shipping_fee DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_payments.alias("p")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("o.id") == F.col("p.order_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.status").isin(["SUCCESS", "FAILED", "REFUNDED"]) | F.col("o.shipping_fee").between(19, 27))
    .select(
        F.col("p.id"),
        F.col("p.order_id"),
        F.col("p.paid_at"),
        F.col("p.amount"),
        F.col("o.shipping_fee"),
        F.col("o.amount").alias("order_amount"),
        F.greatest(F.col("o.discount"), F.col("o.amount")).alias("greatest_discount_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("order_amount").desc(), F.col("shipping_fee").desc())
)

    WHERE NOT (quantity > 7 AND quantity = 6)

WITH filtered_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(monthly_fee * 1.15, 2) AS adjusted_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE plan IN ('basic', 'standard', 'premium') AND end_date <= '2024-03-01'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT QUARTER(start_date) AS start_quarter, SUM(adjusted_monthly_fee) AS total_adjusted_monthly_fee, ROUND(AVG(adjusted_monthly_fee), 2) AS avg_adjusted_monthly_fee

sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 4458000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1002000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, COUNT(*) AS total_count, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(location))) AS location_values
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget > 1972000
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 4458000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1002000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
) AS sub
WHERE total_count >= 4;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget") > 1972000)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 4458000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1002000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("total_count"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("location"))).alias("location_values"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_count") >= 4)
)

sql:
with filtered_suppliers as (
    select *
    from suppliers
    where city not in ('Tokyo', 'New York') or rating < 2.5
),
suppliers_stats as (
    select city, max(rating) - min(rating) as rating_range, count(distinct rating) as unique_citys
    from filtered_suppliers
    group by city
)
select *
from suppliers_stats
order by rating_range desc, city asc
limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_suppliers = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(~F.col("city").isin(["Tokyo", "New York"]) | (F.col("rating") < 2.5))
)

suppliers_stats = (
    filtered_suppliers
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        (F.max("rating") - F.min("rating")).alias("rating_range"),
        F.countDistinct("rating").alias("unique_citys"),
    )
)

result = (
    suppliers_stats
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_range").desc(), "city")
    .limit(3)
)

    )

        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),

WITH src AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget <= 3553000 AND (location = 'Bangkok' OR budget BETWEEN 1142000 AND 1724000)
),
BudgetBucketSummary AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN budget >= 3695000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1034000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket,
        dept_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'Berlin' THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS berlin_budget,
        ROUND(STDDEV(budget), 2) AS stddev_budget
    FROM src
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 3695000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1034000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, dept_name
)
SELECT
    budget_bucket,
    dept_name,
    berlin_budget,
    stddev_budget
FROM BudgetBucketSummary
WHERE stddev_budget >= 73
ORDER BY dept_name, berlin_budget, budget_bucket
LIMIT 20

    .filter((F.col("budget") <= 3553000) & ((F.col("location") == "Bangkok") | F.col("budget").between(1142000, 1724000)))

        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 3695000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1034000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
        "dept_name",

    )
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id = 4
),
last_restock_year_summary AS (
    SELECT
        YEAR(last_restock) AS last_restock_year,
        product_id,
        ROUND(STDDEV(quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity,
        MAX(quantity) AS max_quantity
    FROM base
    GROUP BY YEAR(last_restock), product_id
)
SELECT
    last_restock_year,
    product_id,
    stddev_quantity,
    max_quantity

        F.max("quantity").alias("max_quantity"),

)

SELECT
    MONTH(orders.order_date) AS order_month,
    CASE WHEN orders.discount >= 0.41 THEN 'high' WHEN orders.discount >= 0.11 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS discount_bucket,
    SUM(order_items.unit_price) AS total_unit_price,
    ROUND(STDDEV(order_items.unit_price), 2) AS stddev_unit_price
FROM order_items
LEFT JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id
GROUP BY MONTH(orders.order_date), CASE WHEN orders.discount >= 0.41 THEN 'high' WHEN orders.discount >= 0.11 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END

    .join(df_products.alias("products"), F.col("order_items.product_id") == F.col("products.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.month(F.col("orders.order_date")).alias("order_month"),
        F.when(F.col("orders.discount") >= 0.41, "high").when(F.col("orders.discount") >= 0.11, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("discount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.col("order_items.unit_price")).alias("total_unit_price"),
        F.round(F.stddev(F.col("order_items.unit_price")), 2).alias("stddev_unit_price"),

    SELECT *
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
),

    FROM src

)

FROM summary

LIMIT 5

WITH product_stats AS (

    FROM order_items
    WHERE unit_price <= 160
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.price,
    ps.unique_products,
    ps.avg_quantity

    CASE WHEN unit_price >= 350 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 140 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket,
    MAX(quantity) AS max_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS unique_products,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_items
WHERE order_id IN (18, 35)
GROUP BY unit_price_bucket
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([18, 35]))
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 350, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 140, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("quantity").alias("max_quantity"),
        F.countDistinct("quantity").alias("unique_products"),
        F.sum("quantity").alias("total_quantity"),
    )
)

sql:
WITH filtered_shipments AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN carrier = 'UPS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_ups
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > '2025-01-01' OR status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
),
status_summary AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 73 THEN 'high' WHEN cost >= 37 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS cost_bucket,
        ROUND(AVG(is_ups), 2) AS avg_is_ups,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'DHL' THEN 1 END) AS dhl_count
    FROM filtered_shipments
    GROUP BY status, CASE WHEN cost >= 73 THEN 'high' WHEN cost >= 37 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT
    status,
    cost_bucket,
    avg_is_ups,
    dhl_count
FROM status_summary
WHERE dhl_count >= 8
ORDER BY status, avg_is_ups DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_shipments = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > "2025-01-01") | (F.col("status") == "IN_TRANSIT"))
    .withColumn("is_ups", F.when(F.col("carrier") == "UPS", 1).otherwise(0))
)

status_summary = (
    filtered_shipments
    .groupBy(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("cost") >= 73, "high").when(F.col("cost") >= 37, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("cost_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("is_ups"), 2).alias("avg_is_ups"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "DHL", 1)).alias("dhl_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    status_summary
    .filter(F.col("dhl_count") >= 8)
    .select("status", "cost_bucket", "avg_is_ups", "dhl_count")
    .orderBy("status", F.col("avg_is_ups").desc())
)

sql:
WITH session_stats AS (
    SELECT session_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN 1 END) AS purchase_count, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(page))) AS page_values
    FROM web_events
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.country,
    ss.purchase_count,
    ss.page_values
FROM sessions s
JOIN session_stats ss ON s.id = ss.session_id
WHERE ss.purchase_count >= 6
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

session_stats = (
    df_web_events
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "purchase", 1)).alias("purchase_count"),
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("page"))).alias("page_values"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_sessions.alias("s")
    .join(session_stats.alias("ss"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("ss.session_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("ss.purchase_count") >= 6)
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("ss.purchase_count"),
        F.col("ss.page_values"),
    )
)

sql: WITH valid_departments AS (SELECT *, ROUND(budget * 1.07, 2) AS budget_adjusted FROM departments WHERE dept_name IN ('Sales', 'Legal') AND budget <= 1403000 AND location = 'London'), summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN budget >= 4465000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1924000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS budget_bucket, MAX(budget) AS max_budget FROM valid_departments GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget >= 4465000 THEN 'high' WHEN budget >= 1924000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END) SELECT budget_bucket, max_budget FROM summary WHERE max_budget >= 2018000;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_departments = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isin(["Sales", "Legal"]) & (F.col("budget") <= 1403000) & (F.col("location") == "London"))
    .withColumn("budget_adjusted", F.round((F.col("budget") * 1.07), 2))
)

summary = (
    valid_departments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 4465000, "high").when(F.col("budget") >= 1924000, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("budget_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(F.max("budget").alias("max_budget"))
)

result = (

SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(balance) AS min_balance,
    COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
FROM accounts
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING MIN(balance) >= 68000
ORDER BY num_accounts ASC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_accounts
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("balance").alias("min_balance"),

        F.round(F.avg("balance"), 2).alias("avg_balance"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_balance") >= 68000)
    .orderBy("num_accounts")
)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE (country = 'UK' AND country IN ('US', 'TH')) OR city IN ('Tokyo', 'London')
),
rating_bucket_summary AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN rating >= 4.6 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 1.5 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS rating_bucket, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, MAX(rating) AS max_rating
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN rating >= 4.6 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 1.5 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
)
SELECT rating_bucket, avg_rating, max_rating
FROM rating_bucket_summary
ORDER BY rating_bucket, max_rating;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(((F.col("country") == "UK") & F.col("country").isin(["US", "TH"])) | F.col("city").isin(["Tokyo", "London"]))
)

rating_bucket_summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.6, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 1.5, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("rating").alias("avg_rating"),
        F.max("rating").alias("max_rating"),
    )
)

result = (
    rating_bucket_summary
    .select("rating_bucket", "avg_rating", "max_rating")
    .orderBy("rating_bucket", "max_rating")
)

    COUNT(order_items.unit_price) AS unit_price_count,
    SUM(order_items.unit_price) AS total_unit_price
FROM order_items
INNER JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
INNER JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.id
WHERE order_items.product_id IS NOT NULL

sql:
with base as (
    select *
    from payments
    where status = 'FAILED' and (hour(paid_at) between 7 and 15 or method = 'cash')
),
method_summary as (
    select
        method,
        order_id,
        concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(method))) as method_values,
        count(case when status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 end) as success_count
    from base
    group by method, order_id
)
select *
from method_summary
where success_count < 7
order by method desc, success_count asc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("status") == "FAILED") & (F.hour("paid_at").between(7, 15) | (F.col("method") == "cash")))
)

method_summary = (
    base
    .groupBy("method", "order_id")
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method"))).alias("method_values"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS", 1)).alias("success_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    method_summary
    .filter(F.col("success_count") < 7)
    .orderBy(F.col("method").desc(), "success_count")
)

    FROM transactions
    WHERE account_id = 22
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        merchant,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time) AS txn_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT amount) AS unique_merchants,

    FROM src
    GROUP BY merchant, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time)
)

FROM summary

ORDER BY unique_merchants DESC, debit_count DESC;

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("debit_count"),
    )

SELECT CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 15218 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 7805 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS sqft_bucket, ROUND(STDDEV(ss.revenue), 2) AS stddev_revenue, SUM(ss.units) AS total_units
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN stores s ON ss.store_id = s.id
INNER JOIN products p ON ss.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.stock_qty = 400
GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.sqft >= 15218 THEN 'high' WHEN s.sqft >= 7805 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
ORDER BY sqft_bucket DESC
LIMIT 5
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_store_sales.alias("ss")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("ss.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("ss.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.stock_qty") == 400)
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("s.sqft") >= 15218, "high").when(F.col("s.sqft") >= 7805, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev(F.col("ss.revenue")), 2).alias("stddev_revenue"),
        F.sum(F.col("ss.units")).alias("total_units"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("sqft_bucket").desc())

)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, DATEDIFF(delivered_date, shipped_date) AS days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date FROM shipments WHERE status IN ('DELIVERED', 'LOST')), agg AS (SELECT carrier, MIN(days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date) AS min_days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date, AVG(days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date) AS avg_days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date FROM base GROUP BY carrier) SELECT * FROM agg ORDER BY min_days_shipped_date_to_delivered_date;

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN quantity >= 7 THEN 'high' WHEN quantity >= 3 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS quantity_bucket, order_id, ROUND(AVG(unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(unit_price * quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items WHERE NOT (order_id IN (12, 23, 38) AND (quantity BETWEEN 4 AND 6 OR product_id IN (1, 4, 10))) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING avg_unit_price > 40 ORDER BY revenue;

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("quantity") >= 7, "high").when(F.col("quantity") >= 3, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("quantity_bucket"),
        "order_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("unit_price"), 2).alias("avg_unit_price"),
        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_unit_price") > 40)

)

SELECT
    sessions.device,
    COUNT(web_events.id) AS web_event_count,
    ROUND(STDDEV(web_events.duration_sec), 2) AS stddev_duration_sec,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN web_events.event_type = 'click' THEN 1 END) AS click_count
FROM sessions
LEFT OUTER JOIN web_events ON web_events.session_id = sessions.id
WHERE sessions.country IN ('US', 'DE', 'TH')
GROUP BY sessions.device
ORDER BY click_count DESC;

    df_sessions.alias("sessions")

    .groupBy(F.col("sessions.device"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.col("web_events.id")).alias("web_event_count"),
        F.round(F.stddev(F.col("web_events.duration_sec")), 2).alias("stddev_duration_sec"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("web_events.event_type") == "click", 1)).alias("click_count"),

    .orderBy(F.col("click_count").desc())
)

sql: WITH valid_order_items AS (SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL), order_items_stats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN unit_price >= 430 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 190 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS unit_price_bucket, product_id, ROUND(STDDEV(unit_price), 2) AS stddev_unit_price FROM valid_order_items GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price >= 430 THEN 'high' WHEN unit_price >= 190 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END, product_id) SELECT * FROM order_items_stats WHERE stddev_unit_price > 66 ORDER BY stddev_unit_price DESC, unit_price_bucket, product_id LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_order_items = df_order_items.filter(F.col("quantity").isNotNull())

order_items_stats = (
    valid_order_items
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 430, "high").when(F.col("unit_price") >= 190, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("unit_price_bucket"),

)

result = (
    order_items_stats
    .filter(F.col("stddev_unit_price") > 66)
    .orderBy(F.col("stddev_unit_price").desc(), "unit_price_bucket", "product_id")

sql: with valid_inventory as (select *, datediff(current_date(), last_restock) as days_since_last_restock from inventory where not (store_id in (1, 2, 6) and product_id in (1, 4, 6, 8) and store_id in (2, 4, 5, 6))), summary as (select product_id, month(last_restock) as last_restock_month, round(stddev(quantity), 2) as stddev_quantity, max(days_since_last_restock) - min(days_since_last_restock) as days_since_last_restock_range from valid_inventory group by product_id, month(last_restock)) select product_id, last_restock_month, days_since_last_restock_range from summary order by days_since_last_restock_range, product_id, last_restock_month limit 3;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

valid_inventory = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(~(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 2, 6]) & F.col("product_id").isin([1, 4, 6, 8]) & F.col("store_id").isin([2, 4, 5, 6])))
    .withColumn("days_since_last_restock", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock"))
)

summary = (
    valid_inventory
    .groupBy("product_id", F.month("last_restock").alias("last_restock_month"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("quantity"), 2).alias("stddev_quantity"),
        (F.max("days_since_last_restock") - F.min("days_since_last_restock")).alias("days_since_last_restock_range"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("product_id", "last_restock_month", "days_since_last_restock_range")
    .orderBy("days_since_last_restock_range", "product_id", "last_restock_month")
    .limit(3)
)

)

    FROM order_items
    WHERE quantity BETWEEN 5 AND 8 AND unit_price BETWEEN 120 AND 200 AND unit_price >= 200

agg AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity) revenue, ROUND(STDDEV(unit_price), 2) stddev_unit_price

)

        F.sum((F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity"))).alias("revenue"),

)

sql: select o.status, max(oi.quantity) as max_quantity, avg(oi.quantity) as avg_quantity from order_items oi left join products p on oi.product_id = p.id left join orders o on o.id = oi.order_id group by o.status having max_quantity >= 3.3 order by status desc, avg_quantity desc;
